sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation allows a self-recursive bottom value to be bound but not evaluated when an expression does not demand it.
sketches.resonance: The unbearable can remain in the room if the day learns not to ask for it.

sketches.mechanism: A return executed inside an ensure clause overrides an earlier return from the protected body.
sketches.resonance: The last obligation rewrites the farewell that seemed already decided.
sketches.draft:
def goodbye
  return :gone
ensure
  return :still_here
end

sketches.mechanism: Elimination of the empty type False permits a match with no branches to inhabit any requested proposition.
sketches.resonance: From an impossible witness, every conclusion becomes available and none becomes real.
sketches.draft:
Definition consequence (x : False) : forall A : Prop, A :=
  match x with
  end.
